mechanism_narrative: Higher monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicate stronger residential construction activity, which signals a robust consumer sector and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST is above its 50th percentile (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.0% signals a tightening monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% and industrial production falls below 95.0 (index), it signals a dual deterioration in labor market health and manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0% AND INDPRO < 95.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 230), the tight labor market and elevated inflation signal an impending monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 230 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and overall economic strength, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above its 50th percentile (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals a weakening labor market and economic slowdown, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST > 650.0) combined with high residential sales (RSAFS > 400000.0) indicates robust consumer confidence and economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 650.0 AND RSAFS > 400000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation monetary tightening regime (CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), the central bank's aggressive rate hikes to combat inflation lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS > 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03.
